tei:div.tei:p: "!#'um̐ḥ klong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥ rgyal ba rig 'dzin gyi srog 'khor dpal gyi gdu bu bzhugasaḥ ཿ

dbyings rig rgyal po stang dpyal ngasaḥ dus gsum dus med chen por rgyasaḥ rdo rje can gyi phrin las dngaḥ sngags lam thabs kyis rten cing 'brelaḥ bsam gyis mi khyab brjod mi langaḥ mthong thos reg gam rdzi phyogs phogaḥ btags pas grol ba rig 'dzin gyiḥ srog gi 'khor lo bshad kyis nyonaḥ bri gzhi bzang por rin po chesaḥ mu khyud rim pa bcu gcig dbusaḥ kun bzang yab yum thugs ka ruḥ 'od lnga'i 'khor lo 'bru lngas mtshanaḥ de'i phyi mu khyud gnyis pa laḥ rig pa yab kyi snying po niḥ
man ngag snying thig /

e ma ki ri ki riḥ mas ta bha li bha liḥ sa mi ta su ru su ruḥ kundha li ma su ma suḥ i ka ra su lī bha sa ta yeḥ tsa ki ra bhu li ta lce yeḥ sa mun ta tsarya su gha yeḥ bhi ti sa na bhya gu li yeḥ sa ka ri dhu ka naḥ ma ta ri bhe ta naḥ pa ra hi li sa naḥ ma khar te ke la naḥ saṃ bhu ra ta me ka tsa ra tang paḥ surya gha ta ra e pa sha naḥ ra na bhe dhi sa ghu ti pa yaḥ ghu ra ghu ra sa ga kha ra na laṃḥ na ra na ra i tha pa ṭa laṃḥ sir na sir na bhe sa bhe sa ra sa baṃ laṃḥ bhun dha bhun dhaḥ tshi ṣa sa ke laṃḥ sa sā ri rī khe khāe i ī ma mā ri rī la hā āḥ de'i phyir padma 'dab brgyad laḥ mdun nas brtsam pa'i g.yas skor duḥ
rig 'dzin brgyad kyi snying po/

āoṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ hūm̐ kā ra āḥhūm̐ḥ āoṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ dha na saṃskṛ āḥhūm̐ḥ āoṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ mañdzu shrī mi tra āḥhūm̐ḥ āoṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ bi ma la mi tra āḥhūm̐ḥ āoṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ nā gardzu na āḥhūm̐ḥ āoṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ gu hya tsand+ra āḥhūm̐ḥ āoṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ ā tsarya padma āḥhūm̐ḥ āoṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ shīntaṃ gharbha āḥhūm̐ḥ de'i phyi mu khyud bzhi pa laḥ stong pa yum gyi snying po niḥ mas ta bha li bha liḥ sa mi ta su ru su ruḥ kun dha li ma su ma suḥ e ka ri li bha ta yeḥ tsa ka ra bhu li taḥ lce ye sa man taḥ tsarya su gha bhi ti sa na bhya gu yeḥ ke ri dha ke riḥ dha ha ka ma ha ri bhaḥ ha na sa ri bi hiḥ sa na ma khar takshe la naḥ saṃ bhu da ra ta me ksha tsa ra st+waṃḥ dha ba su tya gha ta ra aḥ ma sha na pa raḥ bhi hiḥ ti sa ghu ra laḥ ma smi sa ya ghu sti la taḥ ya ghu ra ghu raḥ brlang ga kha ka la ra na la ma saḥ na ra na ra lamaḥ i tha ra pa ta laṃḥ sir na bhe sa ral pa ghe laṃḥ ma māḥ sa sa ri rī li lī ma māḥ ra rāḥ mu khyud lnga par rtsibs bcu laḥ
rgyud sde sgyu 'phrul gyi snying po'au/

āoṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭanta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ badzra ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭanta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ ratna ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭanta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ padma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭanta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ karma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭanta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kro dhī shwa rī sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ ma hā badzra dha ra ma hā kro dhī shwa rī dzwa la ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ ma hā surya ratna ma hā kro dhī shwa rī bi da ma hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ hrīḥshatta sa manta padma ma hā kro dhī shwa rī khā hi hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ sarba a mo ghā ma hā kro dhī shwa rī bi shwa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rtsibs mchan laḥ
sgrub sde bka' brgyad kyi snying po/

āoṃ gu ru shrī badzra yaksha kro dha tsitta hūm̐ḥ āoṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ gu hya dzñā na shrī he ru ka gu hya dzñā na kro dhī shwa rī st+waṃ ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ āḥkro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐ḥ āoṃ hrīḥpadma ta krita badzra kro ta hya ghri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ badzra sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ khroṃ ga ru ṭa sarba ḍākki nī hūm̐ phaṭaḥ drug pa thig le nyi shu lngaraḥ karmā raksha ghi haṃ tiḥ bhe gha ra na so gad glingaḥ bhu ka ri la bha du triḥ raṃ pa ka la sa mi khyeḥ ma tang phas pher ras mi taḥ kha ṭa re ka sa mig rlungaḥ a kai ra na bhe tsaka shaḥ ya ri mu ta sa ghu liḥ yā sing ra rlung pa la yāḥ ma ma ko ling sa mantaḥ gha ra yaṃ pa ra mi tiḥ bu ga sing ha pha gha laḥ ra mi se pi kha ta paḥ big khu ma la pa taṃ kiḥ sa ma nye wa dhe ra paḥ badzra satwa tri tro meḥ ghe wa su ghar rna ma yaḥ dharmā pa ti sa gu liḥ ras mi sa ma khas rgad tseḥ ru pa sa mi mi ta liḥ nga tig pa yaṃ ka li saḥ ga tsa pa yaṃ sa i taṃḥ karma e a a nu saḥ saṃ kri ma ma karma taḥ nga la khe pa ki li saḥ bar mtshams longs sku'i snying po dngaḥ rigs drug klong grol yi ge spelaḥ
āoṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ 'a a ha sha sa maḥ bdun par pad 'dab zhe gnyis laḥ
zhi ba'i lha tshogs kyi snying po/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ badzra tsitta āoṃḥ a a a badzri bha dra sa mantaḥ hūm̐ badzra dhrikḥ muṃ dhā te shwa rīḥ āoṃ dzin dzikḥ lāṃ dwe ṣa ra tiḥ swā ratna dhrikḥ māṃ mo ha ra tiḥ āṃ a ro likḥ pāṃ rā ga ra tiḥ hāṃ pra dzñā dhṛkḥ tāṃ badzra ra tiḥ kṣīṃ hi rā dza yaḥ hūm̐ lā sye sa ma ya st+waṃḥ trāṃ ā garbha yaḥ trāṃ mā lye sa ma ya hoḥ hrī ha hūm̐ padma pra da maḥ hrīṃ gī ti rā go haṃḥ dzriṃ ku ru pā ṇiḥ āṃ nirti rā ga ya meḥ me dha ra ṇi swā hāḥ dzaḥdhū pe pra be shaḥ thiṃlha nissa raṃ bha ya swā hāḥ hūm̐ puṣpe ā be shaḥ hūm̐ swa rā dza ya swā hāḥ baṃ dī pa su gi riḥ mūṃ shrī āṃ rā ga ya swā hāḥ hoḥghandhe tsittaḥ āoṃ mu ne kreṃ swā hāḥ āoṃ mu ne hūm̐ truṃ swā hāḥ āoṃ mu ne sruṃ swā hāḥ āoṃ mu ne breṃ swā hāḥ āoṃ mu ne kṣaṃ swā hāḥ āoṃ mu ne ye swā hāḥ āoṃ ya mānta krita phaṭaḥ āoṃ badzra dha ra ma hā kro dhī shwa rī dzwa li nī hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ pra dzñānta krita phaṭaḥ āoṃ ratna dha ra ma hā phaṭaḥ hūm̐ padmanta krita phaṭaḥ āoṃ padma dha ra ma hā phaṭaḥ āoṃ bighnān ta krita phaṭaḥ āoṃ karma dha ra ma hā phaṭaḥ brgyad par khrag 'thung yab yum niḥ
'dus pa mdo'i snying po'o/

āoṃ a kra ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ ka ta ma hā kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āoṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ sarba ta thā ga ta kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ badzra shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ badzra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ buddha shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ buddha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ ratna shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ ratna kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ padma shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ padma kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ karma shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ karma kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ raksha shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ raksha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ sa nu shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ sa nu kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ gu hya shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ gu hya kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ yaksha shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ yaksha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ
gau ri ma brgyad/
āoṃ badzra gau rī haḥ āoṃ badzra tsau rī haḥ āoṃ badzra pra mo ha haḥ āoṃ badzra bai ta lī haḥ āoṃ badzra pukka sī haḥ āoṃ badzra ghasma rī haḥ āoṃ badzra sma sha ni haḥ āoṃ badzra tsaṇḍa li haḥ
singha ma brgyad/

āoṃ badzra singha mu khī heḥ āoṃ badzra bya ghri mu khī heḥ āoṃ badzra sri la mu khī heḥ āoṃ badzra shwa na mu khī heḥ āoṃ badzra gṛddha mu khī heḥ āoṃ badzra kaṅka mu khī heḥ āoṃ badzra kā ka mu khī heḥ āoṃ badzra u lu kā mu khī heḥ dgu par dbang mo nyer brgyad dngaḥ bstan pa spyi yi snying po bkodaḥ ma nu raksha sī bhyoḥ brahma ni bhyoḥ rau trī bhyoḥ beṣṇa bai bhyoḥ ku mā rī bhyoḥ ind+ra rī bhyoḥ badzra piṅga laṃ bhyoḥ a mṛtaṃ bhyoḥ sau mya bhyoḥ daṇḍa daṃ bhyoḥ rakṣa sī bhyoḥ bhakṣa sī bhyoḥ ra ti badzra bhyoḥ ru ti ra matta bhyoḥ e ka tsa ri ṇī bhyoḥ ma no ha raṃ bhyoḥ siddhi kaṃ bhyoḥ bā ya bī bhyoḥ ma hā mā ra ṇa badzra bhyoḥ agnī bhyoḥ bha ra hi bhyoḥ tsa muṇḍi bhyoḥ su ta ni bhyoḥ wa ru ṇī bhyoḥ badzra ma hā kā li bhyoḥ badzra tsa kā la bhyoḥ badzra kumbha karṇa bhyoḥ badzra lambo da ra bhyoḥ āoṃ badzra ārya te dza te nga dzaḥ āoṃ badzra a mu khī hūm̐ḥ āoṃ badzra lo ka baṃḥ āoṃ badzra bhasmi pa la ya ba tu hoḥ a āḥ i īḥ u ūḥ ṛ ṝḥ l̥ l̥̄ḥ e āaiḥ o āauḥ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha ngaḥ tsa tsha dza dzha nyaḥ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇaḥ ta tha da dha naḥ pa pha ba bha maḥ ya ra la waḥ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tunteḥ ṣānta thā ga to hya wa dataḥ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shrā ma ṇaḥ
che ge mo

'i nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sdig sgrib thams cad rig pa'i klong du shīntaṃ ku ru swā hāḥ tshe dang bsod nams zhing khams thams cad rig pa'i ngang du puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ 'khor 'das thams cad rig pa'i ngang du pā shaṃ ku ru swā hāḥ dgra bgegs dug lnga dug gsum thams cad rig pa'i ngang du mā ra ya phaṭaḥ bcu par 'od lnga'i mu khyud bskoraḥ bcu gcig 'od lnga'i pa ṭa risaḥ de nas rab tu gnas pa niḥ yang gsang sgrub pa'i gzhung bzhin laḥ thig le chen po'i snying po rnamasaḥ rtsa sngags nyid dang sbrel la bzlaḥ shis pa brjod cing me tog gtoraḥ rten 'brel snying pos rab tu gnasaḥ dbang bskur byed na sdom pa gsumaḥ cho ga bzhin du bzung byas laḥ bstan bur brgya phyag maṇḍal dbulaḥ tshar gcig bklags la spyi bor bzhagaḥ hoḥ rgyal ba rig 'dzin zhi khro'i lhaḥ btags grol srog gi 'khor lo 'disaḥ skal ldan slob ma
che ge mo

'iḥ sgo gsum smin par mdzad du gsolaḥ grol zhing gang bar mdzad du gsolaḥ rgyas dang 'phel bar mdzad du gsolaḥ kā ya wākka tsitta ratna karmā a bhi ṣiñtsa swā hāḥ zhes brjod gnas lngar gtugs byin rlobasaḥ 'di ni chos sku'i ring bsrel dngosaḥ sde gsum rgyud lung man ngag dngaḥ rgyal ba yongs rdzogs srog 'khor yinaḥ spyi bo mgrin pa mchan khung duḥ sus bcangs sdig pa kun las grolaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba bsnyen dang mtshungasaḥ 'das dus gdung dang ring bsrel dngaḥ sa g.yo sgra 'od 'ja' tshon 'byungaḥ nyi zla gzas zin sa g.yos dngaḥ 'od dang sgra dang sad ser rimasaḥ mu ge phyugs nad byung ba'i tsheḥ byang chub sems dang ldan pa yisaḥ rim bzhin rnam snang mi bskyod paḥ rin 'byung dpag med don grub dngaḥ bzang mo rang rang rigs kyi ljagasaḥ yig 'brus mtshan par bsgom ste bklagasaḥ tshogs dang mchod pa srog 'don dngaḥ mchog dman dud 'gro yan chad laḥ sbyin pa gtong zhing rnal 'byor bsgomaḥ nyin zhag gcig la mtshon pa naḥ snga zhog byer dang dros gting zugaḥ nyin gung snyoms la dgong kha 'khrugaḥ srod byer srod yol 'khrug pa dngaḥ phyed snyoms tho rangs 'khrug pa'i tsheḥ so so'i dus gnad nges pa bzhinaḥ bklag dang tshogs gsag rgya cher byaḥ gsang sngags mos pa can la gsungasaḥ dad pa can la smos ci dgosaḥ rmongs pa'i dud 'gro la btags kyangaḥ thugs rje'i dpyang thag chad pa medaḥ

the tshom log lta can dag niḥ rdo rje can gyi phrin las dngaḥ 'dul tshul thabs kyis spangs pa'i phyiraḥ gsang tshig rig sngags sman dang dpyadaḥ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mthuḥ kun la bskur bas bslu 'gyur zhingaḥ skal pa chad pa snying re rjeḥ 'di dang mjal zhing mos pa rnamasaḥ las 'phro can du gdon mi zaḥ snying thig bstan pa nyams pa'i tsheḥ kun tu bzang pos byin brlabs paḥ rang byung rdo rje dang 'phrad nasaḥ mthong thos dran reg grol bar shogaḥ sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ
